## Prioritized offline-next work

1. **Build conservative successor compatibility admission** (ADR005-OFFLINE-SUCCESSOR-ADMISSION): The bounded 0.2.0/0.2.1 Git-byte and bidirectional structural preflight exists. Remaining work is successor format admission, semantic/security review, real consumer support, release and rollback prerequisites without modifying frozen C.
2. **Audit exports against real support evidence** (ADR005-OFFLINE-SUPPORT-EXPORT-AUDIT): Report exported artifacts, fixture preparation, admitted boundaries and explicit deferrals; surface the ResourceRef preparation/export mismatch without granting support or rewriting C.
3. **Prove provisioned offline package consumption** (ADR005-OFFLINE-NETWORK-DENIED-SMOKE): With an explicitly provisioned immutable dependency cache, install exact C under denied network access and run the existing import/runtime smoke without creating a registry or deployment claim.
